question.text: State the cases of the quadrilateral to be cyclic. Mention all the possible cases.

answers.answer: A quadrilateral is cyclic if two opposite angles are supplementary, or if an exterior angle at a vertex equals the interior angle at the opposite vertex.
solution: Case 1: if two opposite angles of a quadrilateral are supplementary (their sum is $180^\circ$), then the quadrilateral is cyclic (converse of theorem 3).
Case 2: if the exterior angle at a vertex of a quadrilateral equals the interior angle at the opposite vertex, then the quadrilateral is cyclic (corollary).
These are the two cases the lesson gives.
So a quadrilateral is cyclic in these two cases only: supplementary opposite angles, or an exterior angle equal to the interior opposite angle.

checks.resolve_answer: A quadrilateral is cyclic if: (1) two opposite angles are supplementary (sum 180°); (2) an exterior angle at a vertex equals the interior angle at the opposite vertex; (3) two adjacent vertices see the opposite side (equal angles on the same side of it) — i.e. two equal angles drawn on the same base on the same side, e.g. $m(\angle ABD)=m(\angle ACD)$; (4) a side subtends a right angle at the other two vertices (equal-angle special case, the side is a diameter); also, equivalently, there exists a point equidistant from all four vertices (the perpendicular bisectors of the sides meet at one point).

solution: Let AE and CD meet at X.
In BDXE: m(∠BDX) = m(∠BEX) = 90°, so their sum is 180°.
So BDXE is a cyclic quadrilateral (converse of theorem 3).
D and E both see AC at 90°, so ADEC is cyclic.

In ADEC, ∠EDC and ∠EAC are inscribed on arc EC, so they are equal.
Let BX meet AC at F. Then m(∠FBC) + m(∠FCB) = 90°.
BF is the third perpendicular and passes through X.
So the three perpendiculars meet at one point.

solution: The three altitudes make right angles at D, E and F.
So AFXD, CFXE and BDXE are cyclic.
D and E see AC at 90°, so ADEC is cyclic.
F and E see AB at 90°, so AFEB is cyclic.
D and F see BC at 90°, so BDFC is cyclic.
The number of cyclic quadrilaterals is 6.
